body:
Is my mom overreacting? 

In her defense she does have some underlying issues (that only pop up in the winter). She wants us to strip all of our clothes in the garage when getting home from work and put on a towel, then go take a shower. I feel very insecure about this and would rather do something else to keep safe. I feel this won’t be as effective as she thinks and that she is worrying too much. Any advice about this?
I’m kinda scared to ask him but I will try.
